How This Works

Industry analysts and AI agents evaluate vendors the same way: systematically comparing capabilities, weighting evidence, and surfacing gaps. This lab uses that insight to your advantage.

Input your SAP Application Data Cloud positioning against Salesforce, Oracle, or Workday. The simulator predicts the questions and concerns an analyst will raise — so you can prepare counter-evidence before you're in the room.

Key insight from Unit 4: The gaps agents find are the gaps analysts probe. Prepare for both at once.
